answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity with a slashing bond. Each agent must lock real capital before it may vote or grade, and those funds sit on one shared mesa of collateral where misconduct is slashed across the whole group. Creating a thousand identities means posting a thousand bonds, so the marginal cost of a fake account equals the full bond, not the price of a fresh keypair. A fable of cheap pseudonyms collapses once each one must pay. The swarm loses its comet-like advantage: it must burn as much as it hopes to win.
